I’ll read the uncommitted diff, the new files under `tools/gomad3`, the three task requirements, and the named evidence artifacts. I’ll keep the review read-only and use the verdict format you specified.
The change spans three implementation areas: runtime queue filtering, retained success publication, and pin impact reporting. I found the task criteria and the recorded host test result; I’m tracing each implementation against its callers and tests now.
The retained-success collision path looks consistent with the campaign reader, and the runtime queue change preserves head-of-queue progress in the traced path. I’m checking whether it warrants a blocking finding and looking for any other report/build disagreement.
